name: Q1
input: How many inventory slots does a Falchion have?
expected_output: The Falchion (85K-b “Falchion”) has 3 total inventory slots: 2 general cargo slots and 1 dedicated 40mm ammunition slot.

name: Q2
input: How many Components do I need to build 5 Falchions?
expected_output: To build 5 Falchions at a Garage, you need 13,500 Components. Each Falchion costs 135 Refined Materials, so 5 Falchions cost 675 Refined Materials. At 20 Components per Refined Material, 675 * 20 = 13,500 Components.
context: Falchion Garage cost: 135 Refined Materials per vehicle
Refined Material recipe: 20 Components per 1 Refined Material

additional_metadata.note: Reconstructed from ground truth 13,500 Components until Heinrich confirms

name: Q3
input: How many 68mm shells does it take to destroy a Falchion?
expected_output: Destroying an 85K-b Falchion (3,650 HP) with 68mm Anti-Tank ammunition (600 base damage per penetrating hit) requires a minimum of 7 penetrating shots (4,200 total damage). In combat conditions, accounting for armor degradation and penetration chance (varying from ~33% at pristine armor up to ~67% when stripped), it typically takes approximately 12 to 16 shells fired (median of ~14 in simulations).
context: 68mm AT Damage: 600 damage per penetrating hit
Minimum penetrating hits required: ceil(3650 / 600) = 7 hits
Penetration chance range: 33% minimum to 67% maximum
Simulated median shots to destroy: ~14 shells

additional_metadata.note: Ambiguous/probabilistic: requires stating minimum hits (7) and expected range/assumptions (~12-16, median ~14)

name: Q7
input: I'm driving a BMS - Ironship full of crates up the river and encountered a closed drawbridge ahead. How do I get past it? Do I need to get out or bring any tools?
expected_output: You can open the drawbridge directly from inside the vessel by pressing 'E' while steering the BMS - Ironship close to the bridge. You do NOT need to disembark, swim, climb ladders, or walk onto the bridge. You do NOT need any tools (no wrench, hammer, or materials required). Once opened, sail straight through and do not linger underneath, because vessels idling under bridges begin taking damage after a 120-second grace period.
context: Vessel drivers can press 'E' from helm to open or close drawbridges
No disembarkation or ladder climbing needed
No wrench, hammer, or tools required
Linger damage timer on ships under bridges starts at 120 seconds

additional_metadata.note: Agent Eval Failure Report fix - drawbridge interaction mechanics
